# SARIF schema fixture

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the complete SARIF 2.1.0 JSON Schema,
retrieved from https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
on 2026-11-08. Only line endings were normalized from CRLF to LF. It is the normative schema published by OASIS, not a reduced test schema.
Keeping it here allows format validation without network access during tests.
